Title: Public Preview: Additional cache sizes for Azure Cache for Redis Enterprise

Body.Content:
The Enterprise tier of Azure Cache for Redis now offers three additional cache sizes: the E5, E200, and E400 SKUs. These additional sizes allow you to optimize the price/performance of your cache deployments while providing all the same Enterprise features, like vector search capability and active geo-replication. The E5 SKU is our smallest offering, providing a lower price point to get started with the Enterprise tier. The E200 and E400 offerings give even larger options with 200 GB and 400 GB memory sizes, respectively. Because Redis Enterprise can take advantage of the additional vCPUs running on these VMs, the E200 and E400 offerings also provide increased compute performance.

Learn More.
